name: Autopilot
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 10s. Ramjet heating reduced while active.

name: Overcharged Autopilot
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 20s. Gain Overcharged while active.

name: Surging Autopilot
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 15s. Gain Surging while active.

name: Overcharged Autopilot II
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 20s. Gain Overcharged while active. Activating an Ability extends the duration by 5s.

name: Surging Autopilot II
text: Vehicle flies automatically for 15s. Gain Surging and massively increase Speed while active.

name: Concussion Mine
text: Drop a charge that explodes on proximity and applies Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Concussion Mine II
text: Drop 2 charges that explode on proximity and apply Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Freezing Concussion Mine II
text: Drop a charge that applies Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents and emits a lingering Frozen effect. Recover 1 Energy for each affected racer.

name: Concussion Mine III
text: Drop 3 charges that explode on proximity and apply Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Freezing Concussion Mine
text: Drop a charge that applies Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents and emits a lingering Frozen effect.

name: Ion Blast
text: Crash Ability. Emit a blast that applies Disrupted to nearby opponents. Upon reset, gain considerably increased Speed for each affected opponent.

name: Charging Blast
text: Crash Ability. Emit a blast that applies Disrupted to nearby opponents. Upon reset, gain Overcharged, moderately increased Speed, and recover 2 Energy for each affected opponent.

name: Cooling Blast
text: Crash Ability. Emit a blast that applies Disrupted to nearby opponents. Upon reset, gain Cooled for 10s and moderately increased Speed for each affected opponent.

name: Shielding Blast
text: Crash Ability. Emit a blast that applies Disrupted to nearby opponents. Upon reset, gain Shielded for 10s and moderately increased Speed for each affected opponent.

name: Ion Bolt
text: Lock on to the closest nearby opponent and apply Disrupted to target.

name: Concussive Bolt
text: Lock on to the closest nearby opponent and apply Disrupted and Concussed to target.

name: Multi-Bolt
text: Lock on to up to 5 nearby opponents and apply Disrupted to all targets.

name: Concussive Bolt II
text: Lock on to the closest nearby opponent and apply Disrupted and Concussed to target for an extended duration.

name: Multi-Bolt II
text: Lock on to up to 5 nearby opponents and apply Disrupted to all targets. Gain Surging for 5s for each affected opponent.

name: Shield
text: Gain Shielded for 10s.

name: Impact Shield
text: Gain Shielded for 10s. Collisions trigger System Malfunction on opponents.

name: Surging Shield
text: Gain Shielded for 10s. Impacts grant Surging for 5s.

name: Impact Shield II
text: Gain Shielded for 10s. Collisions extend Shielded duration and trigger System Malfunction on opponents.

name: Surging Shield II
text: Gain Shielded, retained until it is broken. Impacts grant Surging for 5s.

name: Shockwave
text: Blast nearby opponents away and apply System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Magnetic Shockwave
text: Pull nearby opponents into proximity before blasting them away and applying System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Vectored Shockwave
text: Blast nearby opponents away, propelling you forward and applying System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Magnetic Shockwave II
text: Pull nearby opponents into proximity before blasting them away and applying System Malfunction and Concussed to affected opponents.

name: Vectored Shockwave II
text: Blast nearby opponents away, propelling you forward with increased power and applying System Malfunction to affected opponents.

name: Status Scrubber
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 1 Energy.

name: Auto-Scrubber
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 1 Energy. Ability activates automatically upon System Malfunction at a cost of 0 Energy.

name: Multi-Scrubber
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 3 Energy.

name: Auto-Scrubber II
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 2 Energy. Ability activates automatically upon gaining any negative status effect at a cost of 0 Energy.

name: Multi-Scrubber II
text: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 4 Energy.

name: Surge
text: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration.

name: Impact Surge
text: Gain Surging for 10s. Overtakes, Takedowns, and vehicle collisions extend the duration​.

name: Overtaking Surge
text: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration and increase its potency.

name: Impact Surge II
text: Gain Surging for 10s. Overtakes, Takedowns, and vehicle collisions extend the duration. Takedowns recharge Energy.

name: Overtaking Surge II
text: Gain Surging for 20s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration and increase its potency.

name: Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat.

name: Flame Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat. Applies Burning and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

name: Vent II
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat for an extended duration.

name: Auto-Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat for an extended duration. Activates automatically upon nearing the end of the Redlining zone.

name: Corrosive Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat. Applies Corroded to nearby opponents.

name: Supercooled Vent
text: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat while gradually gaining Frozen. Upon fully Frozen, Vent disengages.
